security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

bundle.shortDescription: 4X strategy game on the rules of Master of Orion
bundle.longDescription: Age of Orion is a 4X strategy game based on the rules of Master of Orion (1993), ported to Rust from the 1oom engine and compiled to WebAssembly.
